messages:
Priya R: Quick flag 1: our structured-output page has multiple examples that assume the old flat tool return. After the invoke rename some snippets now show an envelope `{ result: ... }` and the JSON Schema examples are stricter (additionalProperties: false). Parser guidance will fail if we don't document envelopes.

Jonas B: Oof. Can you point to one place? I can push a tiny docs PR.

Priya R: Example: /docs/reference/structured-output.md section 'Schema examples'  currently shows `properties: {summary: {type: 'string'}}` and the sample output is `{ "result": { "summary": "..." } }`.

Sophie L: Two quick fixes: 1) add a short note explaining "envelope vs raw" and a one-line unbox helper, 2) add both schema snippets: one for raw and one for the unboxed result. Keeps strict validation while showing the real world.

Jonas B: Agreed. I'll add a tiny TS/JS helper: `const unbox = x => x?.result ?? x;` and a code comment: "compat helper for docs only".

Alex M: Also let's update the example app links while we're here some point to branch refs broke in the last refactor. I'll include link-fixes in the same PR.

CI Bot: New PR draft created by Jonas: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1510 lint:pending, link-check:running

Priya R: Can we add a tiny test to the examples harness that loads the sample responses and runs `unbox` before validating against the schema? That'll prevent this from regressing.

Jonas B: Good idea. I'll add a simple assertion in docs/examples/harness/test_parse_examples.js that calls `unbox` then validates using ajv.

Sophie L: Wording nit: avoid saying "old API" in user-facing guides. Use "previous helper names" and link to migration notes. Keeps tone calmer.

Alex M: I'll review the PR. If CI is green and wording tweaks done, we can merge and then create an issue to remove the compat helper after 2 weeks.

CI Bot: PR #1510: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness passed.

Jonas B: Merged. Added PR note: "compat helper temporary; tracking issue #1525". Thanks all.

Priya R: Great. I'll follow up and add the tracking issue and a short entry in the docs CHANGELOG.

Sophie L: Closing thread  thanks everyone :tada:
